preconditions.description: The input string has a length greater than 0 and less than 1000.

postconditions.description: The output string has a length of 1 or 2 characters.
The output string has 1 character if the input string length is odd, and 2 characters if the input string length is even.

postconditions.expression: output == input[len(input)//2] if len(input) % 2 == 1 else output == input[(len(input)//2)-1:(len(input)//2)+1]
postconditions.description: The output string is the middle character(s) of the input string.
